# mpxj-ts

The Microsoft Project file reader behind johnmcm.com's MPP Viewer
(https://johnmcm.com/mpp-viewer). It reads, in the browser:

- `.mpp` and `.mpt` files from Microsoft Project 98 to 2024 (the "MPP8",
  "MPP9", "MPP12" and "MPP14" formats): a TypeScript port of MPXJ's MPP8,
  MPP9, MPP12 and MPP14 readers, with their working-time calendars;
- Project's XML format (MSPDI);
- MPX;
- Primavera P6 XER (`src/xer.ts`): projects, WBS, activities, relationships,
  resources, assignments and calendars.

## What comes from MPXJ

Ported from MPXJ at commit `3f9244a9c49b052300c2500545cb5ea65340792b`
(6 Oct 2026):

| Here | MPXJ |
| --- | --- |
| `src/blocks.ts` | `mpp/Props14`, `FixedMeta`, `FixedData`, `VarMeta9`, `VarMeta12`, `Var2Data` |
| `src/bytes.ts` | `common/ByteArrayHelper`, `mpp/MPPUtility` |
| `src/fieldmap.ts` | `mpp/FieldMap`, `FieldMap9`, `FieldMap12`, `FieldMap14`, `common/FieldTypeHelper` |
| `src/fieldmap9.ts` | generated by `tools/gen_fieldmap9.py` from `mpp/FieldMap9` |
| `src/fields.ts` | generated by `tools/gen_fields.py` from `TaskField`, `ResourceField`, `AssignmentField` and `common/MPP*Field` |
| `src/mpp14.ts` | `mpp/MPPReader`, `MPP9Reader`, `MPP12Reader`, `MPP14Reader`, `ConstraintFactory`, `ResourceAssignmentFactory`, `ProjectPropertiesReader`, `CompObj` |
| `src/calendars.ts` | `mpp/AbstractCalendarFactory`, `AbstractCalendarAndExceptionFactory`, `MPP9CalendarFactory`, `MPP12CalendarFactory`, `MPP14CalendarFactory`, and the date rules of `RecurringData` |
| `src/mpp8.ts` | `mpp/MPP8Reader`, `FixFix`, `FixDeferFix`, `ExtendedData`, `Props8` |
| `src/mpx.ts` | record and field numbers from `mpx/MPXReader`, `MPXTaskField`, `MPXResourceField` |

`src/xer.ts` reads the tables and codes as MPXJ's `primavera/PrimaveraXERFileReader`,
`TableProjectReader`, `TableContextReader` and `StructuredTextParser` do (from
the same MPXJ checkout), written for this model.

Written for this module: `src/cfb.ts` (OLE compound files, from
Microsoft's [MS-CFB] specification), `src/mspdi.ts` and `src/xml.ts` (from
Microsoft's published MSPDI schema), `src/rtf.ts`, `src/model.ts`,
`src/index.ts`.

Not read: timephased data, views, filters, groups, custom-field value lists
and enterprise custom fields; Project 98's recurring-task definitions (its
recurring tasks are read as the summary tasks and dates Project shows).

## Building

```
python tools/gen_fields.py <path to an MPXJ checkout>     # only when updating MPXJ
python tools/gen_fieldmap9.py <path to an MPXJ checkout>  # likewise
node build.mjs                                          # writes vendor/local/mpxj@9/mpxj.mjs
```

`build.mjs` uses esbuild from the site's `frontend/node_modules`.
